Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Wouter Kuyper" <Wouter...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:44a2da05.04091...@posting.google.com...

> Do i agree my handsize if i play
> 1) Becket Adv
> 2) Visit
> 3) No-replace-events

I don't know what "agree my handsize" means, sorry.

Beckett's ability is independent of any "do not replace" clause.
Visit replaces any "do not replace" clause with a "remove a counter" effect
instead.

> And does it work in other sequences? like 2-3-1? I expect Visit should
> allways be played before the event, right?

Visit must be in effect to alter the event's DNR clause, yes.

> Oh and now i am asking anyway,
> Suppose 2 (or more) other methuselahs play Toreador 7+caps.
> I control Mustafa the Heir. How does vote work?

Once each political action, any older Toreador controlled by another
Methuselah can move 1 blood to Mustafa to force him to cast his votes as
that Toreador's controller chooses.

Note the "Once".

If both want to go first, use 1.6.1.6
